answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The window charges 120 stamped dockets, each costing £29 to have checked before it opens, and the beacon is that the fee never comes back. One name, one proof, one entry: Recognised salt pan keeper work permit backed by the salt pan keepers society enforces it, and a permit keepers hold after evaporation audits is how the check runs. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The ridge is checked, not assumed. The quartz is on the docket.
